proof_scope: The conversational walkthrough control loop: Embry talks at each stop, the human can interrupt her (mid-speech by keypress/voice, or at the pause), she acknowledges and pauses, and the human can ask a different question (which she answers grounded in the paused state) or navigate (continue/back/repeat/quit) before she resumes. Driven by scripted --commands so the loop is verifiable without a live human; capability-gated on a trusted VS Code bridge.

claims.proves: vscode_walkthrough.py runs a pause-and-listen loop: it narrates a stop, accepts an interrupt that makes Embry pause, answers a mid-walkthrough question grounded in the paused state, resumes on continue, and stops the whole walkthrough on quit
claims.does_not_prove: the correctness/quality of an LLM-generated answer, or live microphone barge-in (the mid-speech keypress/voice interrupt is exercised live separately; here the interrupt and commands are scripted)

cases.name: interrupt-question-resume
cases.description: At stop 1 the human interrupts (Embry pauses), asks a different question (she answers from the paused state), then continues; the walkthrough resumes to stop 2 and completes.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; if [ -z "$WS" ]; then WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; fi; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.converse.json --workspace "$WS" --commands 'interrupt;what should second be?;continue;continue' --wait-seconds 30

cases.name: human-quits-the-walkthrough
cases.description: The human can stop the whole walkthrough at any pause with quit, not just skip one line.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; if [ -z "$WS" ]; then WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; fi; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.converse.json --workspace "$WS" --commands 'quit' --wait-seconds 30

cases.name: fails-closed-without-live-bridge
cases.description: With a workspace not open in VS Code, the conversational walkthrough fails closed (BRIDGE_BLOCKED, exit 3).
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.converse.json --workspace "$WS" --commands 'continue;continue' --wait-seconds 6
